description: Paviršinio vandens monitoringo duomenys is a dataset listed in data.gov.lt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Klaipėdos miesto savivaldybės administracija. The data set presents the general physico-chemical and biological parameters of surface water bodies: Nb, Pb, NO3-N, NH4-4, PO4-P, BDS7 and others. The purpose of surface water monitoring is to assess the ecological status / ecological potential of Klaipėda city surface water bodies. Coverage: Klaipėdos miesto savivaldybės administracija. The portal shows the English title as "Surface water monitoring data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Klaipėdos miesto savivaldybės administracija. Its keywords include Vandens Telkinių Tarša, Paviršinis Vanduo, Vandens Telkiniai, Vanduo. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.lt). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lt.
